title: Material
description: A material (#774): an item the loot, harvest and chest tables may give that isn't a piece of gear, kept in the player's profile by its id with how many they have. One file per material, named after its id, so the content flow can refuse a table naming an item that doesn't exist. An id is never reused or changed once shipped.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

model.description: Its 3D model (every item has one, #1579): a res:// path to a glTF model under assets/ that exists. Optional until every material has one (#1585, #1586).
